facts.claim: BookDB2 is presented as a Windows candidate.
facts.source_quote: 1. **BookDB2 — strongest direct Windows workflow match.** Its developer describes books with authors, categories and publishers, plus borrower records, multiple copies and loans. Caveats: I did not establish an open-source license or test for a login prompt, and the developer says development of BookDB3 stalled and BookDB2 will not be updated. Sources: https://spacejock.com/BookDB.html ; https://spacejock.com/BookDB_Faq.html ; https://spacejock.com/BookDB_Download.html . The retrieved feature/download pages were last modified on 1 August 2026, so this run has not established the same capabilities were available by 4 February 2017.

facts.source_quote: 2. **Tellico — strongest documented Linux alternative.** This GPL collection manager supports manual book entry, authors, grouping, custom fields and translations. It saves its data as XML without a database server. The official changelog also documents loan and borrower integration. That makes a desktop collection manager a plausible way to cover your needs with less administration than a full ILS. Linux is the platform clearly supported by the retrieved overview; I did not verify a Windows package or an explicit no-login guarantee. Sources: https://tellico-project.org/about-tellico/ ; https://tellico-project.org/tellico-changelog/ . The changelog dates Tellico 3.0 to 8 November 2016 and 2.3.12 to 29 January 2017, establishing pre-cutoff releases, although the overview describes the current product.

uncertainties.candidate: Caddy with its templates and file_server handlers
uncertainties.claim: Using Caddy's request-header API to select a layout via HX-Request is a proposed mapping, not a tested HTMX preset.
uncertainties.source_quote: Caddy's file server provides the static-file side. Its template handler can process file responses and include other HTML files. The template API exposes request headers through .Req.Header.Get, so you can use HX-Request to choose whether to include the surrounding page layout. Shared layout files can hold common content, while page-specific files supply each page's material. This is a mapping of documented capabilities, not a claim that I ran your site or found a turnkey HTMX preset. [File server](https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile/directives/file_server) · [Templates](https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile/directives/templates) · [Template API](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2/modules/caddyhttp/templates)
